description: Elections Commission - Amended Notice for Local Authorities in Rathnapura District (Order under Section 38(3) of the L. A. E. O.)
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with electoral processes, specifically the postponement of local authority elections and the announcement of a new election date. It references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, provides notice of poll changes, and lists the affected local government bodies. This falls squarely under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it involves election scheduling and administrative matters related to the electoral process.
